subject: Startups
title: The Uber Seed Round
description: A quick win: understand The Uber Seed Round.

hook.text: Uber's first investor put in $200K. By IPO, that stake was worth hundreds of millions of dollars.

buildup.text: First Round Capital led Uber's seed in 2010. The idea—tap a button and a car appears—seemed like luxury for the rich.

discovery.text: Early investors saw Uber's data: once people tried it, they never went back to calling cabs. Retention was perfect.

twist.text: Dozens of investors passed. The co-founders pitched 200+ people. Most said ride-sharing would never scale.

climax.text: Uber reached a $75 billion IPO. The seed investors who said yes turned tiny checks into generational wealth.

punchline.text: Two hundred rejections. One yes. A $75 billion company.
